narrative.overview: Casify presents modern phone cases through the material language of a warmly lit 1920s confectionery. The shop dressing creates recognition and delight, while the product photograph, model choice, price, and service facts remain direct and authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper-and-cocoa foundation with red as the primary commercial signal.
Real product imagery centered inside crafted shop displays.
Die-cut tickets, striped trims, brass accents, and glass highlights as recurring material cues.
Expressive motion that settles into a readable state and respects reduced motion.

rules.name: The Red Means Action Rule
rules.body: Preserve candy red for brand structure and high-value action so it remains immediately legible.

rules.name: The One Flourish Rule
rules.body: A composition may use one script-led flourish; all decisions and evidence stay in display, body, or label type.

rules.name: The Physical Cause Rule
rules.body: Every shadow should imply a real edge, hanging object, glass pane, or lifted card; never add glow solely for decoration.

dos: Do let real product photography remain the sharpest and most authoritative object in each shopping scene.
Do use the established cream, cocoa, candy red, muted teal, and aged-gold palette before introducing a new hue.
Do make model, price, shipping, returns, and dispatch facts readable before decorative detail.
Do give animation an explicit pause path when it auto-runs and a complete static fallback when JavaScript is unavailable.
donts: Don't use generic gradient-heavy tech styling, neon glows, or a dark campaign world that detaches from the header and footer.
Don't invent product performance, review, shipping, or guarantee claims to fill a composition.
Don't place an eyebrow label above every heading; hierarchy should come from the heading, spacing, and content itself.
Don't shrink core mobile labels below practical reading size or truncate model-fit information.
